about: The one table of the models SoundTap installs on, read by install.sh, install.ps1 and index.html. A rule matches the <type> of the speaker's :8090/info exactly (typeContains: as a substring) and, when it names one, its <moduleType>. No installer checks the Bose software version: an install has been recorded from 20.0.6 on the Wireless Link, 22.0.3 on the SoundTouch 10 and 27.0.6 on the others (docs/owners/install.md). Unsupported rules are checked first, then the preview rules, then the supported ones ("supported": true), so a SoundTouch 20 that reports the Series III's sm2 module is the Series III preview and never reaches the Series I/II rule; a speaker no rule matches is not supported. Preview rules ("preview": true) name models SoundTap boots from what Bose's software shows but nobody has run it on (docs/owners/compatibility.md#previews): every installer offers them only when picked by name and after an extra confirmation. The Lifestyle 600/650 module (sm2) has no way back at all and is refused; an SM2 Lifestyle adapter reports what the installers cannot tell from it, so only the SCM adapter is a preview. Keep one rule per line: install.sh reads it line by line.
